# Phase 7b widening, generated by scripts/phase7_widening.py

Three measurements. The store mode reads the registered run. The paired mode refits each origin and simulates the point model and its twin with the same innovation draws, so the ratio is the parameter effect without innovation noise; it is shown for test origins and for the dev origins the gate was registered from. Runtimes in the paired sections were measured on a shared two-core machine and are indicative.

Regenerate:

```
uv run python scripts/phase7_widening.py store configs/phase7b/runs/<run_id>
uv run python scripts/phase7_widening.py paired configs/phase7b/phase7b.yaml --role test
uv run python scripts/phase7_widening.py paired configs/phase7b/phase7b.yaml --role dev
```
